title: backlog.py check warns of an item whose check opens a repository file no touch covers
goal: backlog check warns of an item whose check opens a repository file that none of its touches covers, naming the item and the file

run:
import os, sys, json, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
os.makedirs(os.path.join(T, 'kb/_self/backlog'))
shutil.copy('backlog.json', T)
item = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', '866e5fdae:kb/_self/backlog/ST-lvcvosht.json'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
d = json.loads(item); d.pop('depends_on', None); d.pop('sprint', None); d['status'] = 'draft'
open(os.path.join(T, 'kb/_self/backlog/ST-lvcvosht.json'), 'w').write(json.dumps(d, indent=2) + '\n')
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, 'check'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
out = p.stdout + p.stderr
hit = [l for l in out.splitlines() if 'ST-lvcvosht' in l and 'agents/worker.md' in l]
print('warning lines:', hit); sys.exit(0 if hit else 1)

clauses.clause: backlog check warns of an item whose check opens a repository file that none of its touches covers, naming the item and the file

notes: retrospective of SP-ttgcpf7o: ST-lvcvosht was planned with a check that reads agents/worker.md, outside its touches, so its done would have refused the worker's edit there; the orchestrator found it by reading the item before the claim (commit 4f7623645f). The planted copy is ST-lvcvosht as the sprint started (866e5fdae). Touches name bl_check.py as the likely home: widen at plan time with referrers.
